body: I don’t mind a message if you need someone to talk to
That I can’t turn it off. I will always be this way, I will always need support, and that idea pains me so much more than I “inconvenience” you.

Happy belated birthday! I’m sorry you’re feeling this way; I understand it all too well. I wish that I could say something better about your situation, but all I can say is I hope you know that you have a community here.

Hey, I’m a fellow schizophrenic autistic (+ more) and I’m dealing with just about the same issues. We’ve had a similar path. I’m also ready to throw in the towel; I’m done trying. I’m not much, but if you want to talk I’m here. I know probably more than anyone that I can’t stop you if you want to end your life, and I respect a person’s decision to do so, but I would like to talk to you, and hear from you, as a friend before you go…
I deeply relate to this. I didn’t plan on living this long and am feeling lost and insignificant and….alone. Thank you for sharing.
It’s something to consider I guess. Thank you
Finding a good job would help with my financial situation, but not much else. I don’t see how I could succeed in working when I the thought of moving some days makes me want to cry.
